_note: Market rules (designer's): a thing sells back for a little less than it costs (buy = sell x markup), so crafting stays the cheaper way and buy-and-resell never pays. Stock and wares open up as islands are cleared.

extraSlots._note: Work slots past the fifth, one skill at a time (design.md: an endgame gold sink). Needs the skill's five slots open first.

limited.name: A single Aether Pearl
limited.blurb: Pressed from the far islands' Aether. Spend it on Pearl upgrades in Sanctum Works.

limited.name: Shimmering egg
limited.blurb: An egg with a shimmer in its shell. What hatches is always shiny.

limited.name: Gilded egg
limited.blurb: One grade above the best egg the Egg Market sells you today.

limited.name: Crystal hoard
limited.blurb: A crate of Aether Crystals at a collector's price. Shatter them in the Inventory.

list.name: Aether Incense
list.desc: +50% Aether from perches and the Resonance Extractor.

list.name: Glimmer Lure
list.desc: Wild Aetherlings rarer than Dim turn up twice as often.

list.name: Tinker's Brew
list.desc: Every worker finishes its actions 20% faster.

eggs._note: Market eggs hold a random base Aetherling of one type you own. Grades set the lowest rarity; odds above it are rarityOdds. They never count toward the hatch pity.
